description: Seed registry for DimConcepts. 'name' is the canonical value for DimConcepts.concept_name. 'aliases' are surface forms mapped to it; unlike technologies there is no ConceptAlias table in schema.sql, so they widen prompt matching and are dropped at load time. 'category' has no column either; keep it or drop it at load time. Named products, tools and vendors do not belong here, they live in seeds/technologies.json: this registry holds what a posting asks you to know rather than what it asks you to operate. Spanish surface forms are aliases because the postings are mixed-language while the canonical name stays English.

concepts.name: authorization
aliases: control de acceso basado en roles

concepts.name: personal data protection law
aliases: ley de proteccion de datos personales
